name: Windsor.ai for E-commerce
description: Windsor.ai for E-commerce is a focused workspace for online stores and marketplaces. It connects your store and marketplace sources, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Klaviyo, and Google Merchant Center, so you can ask questions in plain language: track sales, orders, and top products; and monitor marketplace and shopping-feed performance. Where the platform supports it, you can also make changes, such as updating a product listing, always after you confirm. It connects only your e-commerce sources, so the tools stay on task. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Windsor.ai for E-commerce to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Windsor.ai for E-commerce to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.windsor.ai/ecommerce. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Windsor.ai for E-commerce MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for E-commerce lists 18 MCP tools, including contact_windsor, create_custom_field, create_destination_task, execute_action, get_connector_authorization_url, get_connector_connect_info, get_connectors, get_current_user, get_custom_fields, get_data, get_destination_setup_info, and get_destination_tasks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Windsor.ai for E-commerce?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Windsor.ai for E-commerce in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Windsor.ai for E-commerce MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for E-commerce requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Windsor.ai for E-commerce is developed by Windsor.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
